name: How can I prepare for an initial consultation with AKN Design Group for my custom bathroom project?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare for an initial consultation with AKN Design Group for my custom bathroom project?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for your initial consultation for a custom bathroom project, consider gathering any inspiration photos, noting preferred styles or features, and identifying specific challenges or desires for your current bathroom. Thinking about your budget range and how you envision using the new space will also be helpful. This preliminary preparation allows us to gain a comprehensive understanding of your needs and begin crafting a tailored design strategy for your luxury bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a consultation by gathering inspiration, noting preferred features, and considering your budget and functional needs for the new space.
